g.text: BrowseSafe++: effect of adding the user task
Balanced error = (false-alarm rate + missed-attack rate) / 2. Positive = task lowers this average.
Native panels share 2,850 groups; Sol has a separate 498-group cohort. Not a model ranking. Only native tests have Holm adjustment.
Missing-outcome bounds use a different, all-planned cohort; see source tables. No new statistical fitting.
